-c
<REPO>/api/openapi.yaml
-s
<URL>
--headers=<DIR>/headers.yml
--no-checkUpdate
--noEnvFile
--refData=<DIR>/refdata.yml
-o
<OUT>/report
--maxRequestsPerMinute=10000
--printExecutionStatistics
--skipPaths=/v1/admin/reset,/v1/admin/signing-keys/rotate,/v1/admin/identities/{identity}/reset-credential,/v1/admin/bridges,/v1/admin/bridges/{channel}
